rows.name:
Mechon attacks on the village are leading to many[XENO:n ]
residents getting injured. There isn't enough medicine[XENO:n ]
to treat them all. Collect some medicinal materials.

Collect 5 lots of [System:Color name=item ]Krabble Back Moss[/System:Color] from[XENO:n ]
Oros Krabbles on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Vortec.

You got the items needed for the medicine,[XENO:n ]
but there are still dangerous Mechon in the area.

The location of the Mechon threatening the village has[XENO:n ]
been discovered. It's near Digit 1 Crevasse. Take out[XENO:n ]
this group of Mechon by destroying their leader!

Destroy the [System:Color name=item ]Broken Mechon[/System:Color] in the area of[XENO:n ]
Digit 1 Crevasse.
Return to Vortec.

You dealt with the Mechon that was attacking[XENO:n ]
the villagers. Things should be peaceful now.

There are some strange noises coming from the silver[XENO:n ]
Face wreckage on the beach. Primo is too scared to go[XENO:n ]
and fetch water. Find out the cause of the noise.

Investigate the Silver Wreckage on Wreckage[XENO:n ]
Beach on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Primo.

You found the cause of the noise and reassured[XENO:n ]
Primo. Now she can return to her water fetching.

When Elena was looking around the village for parts,[XENO:n ]
she saw some large Mechon. Defeat the large[XENO:n ]
Mechon so they don't pose a danger to the village.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]M85 Meteor Artillery[/System:Color] units on the[XENO:n ]
Fallen Arm.
Return to Elena.

You defeated the large Mechon before they[XENO:n ]
posed a danger to the villagers.

Because the large Mechon were defeated, the other[XENO:n ]
Mechon have gone on a rampage. They could[XENO:n ]
cause some real damage! Cull their numbers.
Defeat 10 [System:Color name=item ]M56 Prototypes[/System:Color] on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Elena.

You reduced the numbers of Mechon and the[XENO:n ]
villagers are safer now.

Orpheus stopped growing at some point. If you have[XENO:n ]
the right materials, you will be able to build a device[XENO:n ]
that will rectify this. Gather what is needed.
Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Transmission Bypass[/System:Color].
Collect an [System:Color name=item ]Exhaust Pump[/System:Color].
Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Mini Reactor[/System:Color].
Return to Orpheus.

Shulk built the device with the materials and[XENO:n ]
has given it to Orpheus.

Defeat the Offensive Strike Unit, which is in the area[XENO:n ]
of the Black Wreckage on the Fallen Arm, and collect[XENO:n ]
a Transmission Bypass.

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Transmission Bypass[/System:Color] from the[XENO:n ]
Offensive Strike Unit.

Collected a Transmission Bypass from the[XENO:n ]
Offensive Strike Unit.

Defeat the Offensive Hover Unit, which is in the area[XENO:n ]
of Digit 4 on the Fallen Arm, and collect an Exhaust[XENO:n ]
Pump.

Collect an [System:Color name=item ]Exhaust Pump[/System:Color] from the[XENO:n ]
Offensive Hover Unit.

Collected an Exhaust Pump from the[XENO:n ]
Offensive Hover Unit.

Defeat the Experimental M86 near Digit 2 Plain on[XENO:n ]
the Fallen Arm and collect a Mini Reactor.

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Mini Reactor[/System:Color] from the[XENO:n ]
Experimental M86.

Collected a Mini Reactor from the[XENO:n ]
Experimental M86.

The memory chips which record how the Machina[XENO:n ]
used to live are scattered throughout Machine God Field.[XENO:n ]
Help return these memories for them.

Collect 4 [System:Color name=item ]Memory 925 Pieces[/System:Color] from[XENO:n ]
Machine God Field.
Return to Rillet.

Some of the memories are damaged, but at least[XENO:n ]
most of them have been returned.

According to Rillet, the most important memory chip of[XENO:n ]
all still remains in the capital. It's not clear what this[XENO:n ]
memory is of, but recover it for him anyway.

Collect [System:Color name=item ]Memory 903[/System:Color] in the Judicial District[XENO:n ]
of Agniratha.
Return to Rillet.

You returned the villagers' precious memories.[XENO:n ]
They are so happy to have them back.

Rei has trouble rescuing people from the water[XENO:n ]
because he's a Machina. Help him collect materials[XENO:n ]
that will turn him into a Homs.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Silver Lexos Hearts[/System:Color] from Lexos in[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Pretty Flamii Legs[/System:Color] from Kukukoro Flamii[XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.
Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Poisonous Corals[/System:Color] on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Rei.

You collected the right materials but it didn't[XENO:n ]
work. Rei needs a new plan.

Monsters have been gathering around the village for[XENO:n ]
some unknown reason. You can't leave them there![XENO:n ]
Protect the Machina and their village!
Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]M35 Prototypes[/System:Color] on the Fallen Arm.
Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Aura Antols[/System:Color] on the Fallen Arm.
Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Lampo Ponios[/System:Color] on the Fallen Arm.
Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Prado Upas[/System:Color] on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Rei.

You defeated the monsters and ensured the[XENO:n ]
safety of the village.

Rei wants to be able to protect the village himself.[XENO:n ]
To do this, he needs a special fibre. Collect some of[XENO:n ]
this fibre for him.

Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Silver Antol Fibres[/System:Color] that are very rarely[XENO:n ] 
dropped by Antols on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Rei.

By implanting the fibre into his muscles, Rei's[XENO:n ]
body has become significantly more powerful.

The door of Leanna's home is so old that it's broken,[XENO:n ]
but she doesn't have the materials needed to fix it.[XENO:n ]
Collect the materials that she needs.
Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Digital Filaments[/System:Color] on the Fallen Arm.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Dated Frames[/System:Color] from the M56 Prototypes[XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Leanna.

You gave Leanna the items to fix her door.[XENO:n ]
She can get back in her house now.

When Leanna got back in her house she found that[XENO:n ]
her beloved mechanical flower had wilted. Collect[XENO:n ]
what she needs to return it to its former glory.

Collect some [System:Color name=item ]Pure Water[/System:Color] from Zakt Spring[XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Leanna.

Collect 5 lots of [System:Color name=item ]Electric Upa Tears[/System:Color] from Prado[XENO:n ]
Upas on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Leanna.

The flower swiftly recovered, and Leanna seemed[XENO:n ]
overjoyed to see it.

When he was in the Defence Force, Caral swore an[XENO:n ]
oath with a friend. Now, he has lost the precious[XENO:n ]
sword on which they swore that oath. Help him find it.

Find the [System:Color name=item ]Oath Sword[/System:Color] in the area of the Power[XENO:n ]
Pipe Ruins on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Caral.

You have returned the sword to Caral and he[XENO:n ]
is even more determined to keep his promise.

The exhaust system is inspected every ten years.[XENO:n ]
Jeki has a bad feeling about this year's inspection.[XENO:n ]
Go check on the exhaust system for her.

Go to the Ether Exhaust System and eliminate[XENO:n ]
any problems in the area.
Return to Jeki.

There were Mechon in the Exhaust System.[XENO:n ]
You've dealt with them, so Jeki need not worry.

Kyles has made a gun using the latest technology, but[XENO:n ]
can't use it properly. This is making protecting the[XENO:n ]
village area difficult. Patrol the area for him.

Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Offensive Seeker Units[/System:Color] on the[XENO:n ]
Fallen Arm.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Caelum Volff[/System:Color] on the Fallen Arm.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Lelepago Pterix[/System:Color] on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Kyles.

You ensured the safety of the village for Kyles,[XENO:n ]
but something is still on his mind...

Kyles has given up on trying to use the advanced gun,[XENO:n ]
and decided to make a new gun that he can use.[XENO:n ]
Collect the materials he needs to defend the village.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Reinforced Thrusters[/System:Color] from[XENO:n ]
M91/DOGMA Mechon in Machine God Field.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Advanced Frames[/System:Color] from M53/THANK[XENO:n ]
Mechon units in the Central Factory.
Return to Kyles.

Kyles's new gun is perfect for him and his fellow[XENO:n ]
Machina. He gave the old gun to you as thanks.

Stress has caused Ein to start acting strangely.[XENO:n ]
Everyone is worried about him. Talk to Ein and[XENO:n ]
see if there is a way to help him.
Speak with Ein.
Speak with Ein again.
Have another chat with Ein.
Have yet another chat with Ein.
Return to Elena.

Ein has cheered up because you listened to[XENO:n ]
his woes.

Minis's parents are arguing over a broken keepsake,[XENO:n ]
and she wants to stop them. Talk to both parents to[XENO:n ]
find out more about the keepsake in question.

Ask Minis's father, Kyles, about the necessary[XENO:n ]
materials, and collect them.

Ask Minis's mother, Euphoria, about the necessary[XENO:n ]
materials, and collect them.
Return to Minis.

The keepsake is fixed and the parents have[XENO:n ]
made up. The family is happy again.

Two items are necessary to fix the keepsake.[XENO:n ]
Kyles has forgotten one, but remembers the other.[XENO:n ]
Collect some Flier Bloom Scales.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Flier Bloom Scales[/System:Color] from Happiness[XENO:n ]
Fliers on the Fallen Arm.

You collected the Flier Bloom Scales needed[XENO:n ]
to repair the keepsake.

Two items are necessary to fix the keepsake.[XENO:n ]
Euphoria has forgotten one, but remembers the other.[XENO:n ]
Collect some Bronze Wood.

Collect 3 pieces of [System:Color name=item ]Bronze Wood[/System:Color] from[XENO:n ]
Machine God Field.

You collected the Bronze Wood needed[XENO:n ]
to repair the keepsake.

It is Natalia's job to take food to those keeping watch[XENO:n ]
outside the village. However, she hasn't been feeling[XENO:n ]
too well, so take it to Theo for her.

Take the food to Theo who is at the base of[XENO:n ]
Digit 2.
Take the Deepwater Fish to Natalia.

You took the food to Theo for Natalia and[XENO:n ]
helped Theo return the favour.

When it rains you can find Tears of the Sky on the[XENO:n ]
fingertips of the Fallen Arm. Calbora is too scared of[XENO:n ]
heights to go and fetch one. Collect one for him.

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Tear of the Sky[/System:Color] from Distant Fingertip[XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm. (Only during a thunderstorm.)
Return to Calbora.

You collected a Tear of the Sky for Calbora.[XENO:n ]
But it looks like he has another request...

Bozerone is at the Machina Refuge in Machine God Field.[XENO:n ]
Calbora cannot go there because of his fear of heights.[XENO:n ]
Take the Tear of the Sky there for him.
Take the Tear of the Sky to Bozerone.

Bozerone has still not returned to the village but[XENO:n ]
she is very happy to have a Tear of the Sky.

Shulk finds Fiorung inside the silver Face, unconscious[XENO:n ]
but still alive! You have to find a way to help her.

Investigate the beach and get some water[XENO:n ]
for Fiorung.
You collected some Clean Water.

Shulk and the others became separated in the[XENO:n ]
confusion. He and Fiorung found themselves on a[XENO:n ]
beach. The others must be nearby!
Find your friends.
Find the rest of your friends.
You found everyone and they are all safe.

According to Linada, the only way to treat Fiorung is by[XENO:n ]
building a circulation system. You need to find a[XENO:n ]
Piezoelectric Unit to control the system.

Find a [System:Color name=item ]Piezoelectric Unit[/System:Color] amongst the Mechon[XENO:n ]
wreckage on Digit 5 Beach of the Fallen Arm.
Take the [System:Color name=item ]Piezoelectric Unit[/System:Color] to Linada on Junks.

You have given the Piezoelectric Unit to Linada.[XENO:n ]
Fiorung should be OK now.
